entities.name: Kodama of the North Tree
entities.description: Kami of the Winter Tree of the Jukai, one of the Five Trees, who values survival above all else.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: Forest of Kamigawa containing the Winter Tree.

entities.name: Winter Tree
entities.description: One of the Five Trees; the Kodama's tree.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War during which the kodama woke.

events.summary: During the Kami War the Kodama of the North Tree woke, like a slumbering angry bear.
events.quote: during the war, it woke and became like a slumbering angry bear
